latency.method: Primary: a pad probe on each ingest pipeline's v4l2src src pad stamps every camera buffer with CLOCK_MONOTONIC, keyed by (source, camera PTS); the PTS is unchanged through the ingest pipeline into the latest-frame slot. The output clock's emit observer reports every tick: its output PTS (tick x period), whether it emitted a fresh frame, a repeat or a placeholder, and the frame's source and camera PTS; a bounded side table maps the output PTS to that emission and to the fresh frame's camera src-pad time. A pad probe on the output's v4l2sink sink pad joins the buffer by output PTS. Added latency = sink-ready time - camera src-pad time, fresh frames only: the delay our stages add over an app reading the camera directly, including the wait for the next output tick (0 to 1 output period). Sink-ready = after the sink probe maps the buffer readable: cudadownload hands v4l2sink GstCudaMemory-backed buffers and CUDA work is asynchronous, so kernels and the device->host copy complete on first map; the probe's map does exactly the work v4l2sink's own map would do next. added_at_sink_pad_ms (before that map) is a secondary figure and under-states the cost. Output fps counts every buffer at the v4l2sink sink pad by arrival time, in 1 s windows. Via consumer (measured runs only): a bench-only probe writes the output PTS into the first 16 luma bytes just before v4l2sink; an in-process consumer pipeline (v4l2src on the loopback ! fakesink) decodes it on arrival on the same clock: camera src pad -> consumer receipt, fresh frames only. Limits: excludes sensor exposure and USB transfer (identical for a direct reader, so it cancels); excludes the consumer app's own render/display (no glass-to-glass measurement); the stamp alters 16 luma pixels in measured runs only. gst_latency_query is what elements declare, not a measurement.

teardown.note: GStreamer destroys its CUDA context when the pipelines reach NULL; remaining /dev/nvidia* fds (if any) are the CUDA driver's process-wide handles from cuInit, released only at process exit
